file_insights.changes: Enhanced write_gallery() function with security meta tags and CSP hash computation
key_additions: Extracted inline CSS and JavaScript content as string variables
Implemented CSP hash computation for three inline content blocks
Built Content-Security-Policy directive with hash-based validation
Added four security meta tags to HTML header
file_insights.impact: Significantly improved security posture of generated HTML output

patterns_discovered.description: Computing SHA-256 hashes of inline styles and scripts to enable CSP without relaxing policies
patterns_discovered.benefit: Allows inline content while maintaining strict Content Security Policy

patterns_discovered.description: Multiple complementary security meta tags (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, referrer)
patterns_discovered.benefit: Layered security approach protecting against multiple attack vectors

patterns_discovered.description: Inline CSS and JS extracted as string variables before hash computation and header insertion
patterns_discovered.benefit: Enables programmatic hash validation while maintaining source of truth for inline content

gotchas_discovered.description: Inline CSS and JavaScript strings must match exactly with what's rendered in HTML, or CSP will block execution
gotchas_discovered.risk: Any formatting changes or whitespace differences will cause CSP violations
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Maintain strict version control and testing of inline content

gotchas_discovered.description: Code assumes compute_csp_hash() function exists and works correctly, but not visible in diff
gotchas_discovered.risk: Runtime error if function is missing or has bugs
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify function implementation and add error handling

gotchas_discovered.description: Inline CSS (2000+ chars) and JavaScript (1000+ chars) increase write_gallery() complexity
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider extracting to constants or external files

discoveries.approach_outcome: SUCCESS - Successfully implemented CSP with hash-based validation for inline content while adding multiple security headers. The implementation maintains backward compatibility with existing meta tags and follows a defense-in-depth security strategy.

recommendations.recommendation: Extract inline CSS and JavaScript to external files to eliminate CSP hash dependencies and improve maintainability
recommendations.rationale: Reduces code complexity and eliminates risk of hash mismatches due to formatting changes

recommendations.recommendation: Verify compute_csp_hash() function implementation and add error handling
recommendations.rationale: Critical dependency not visible in diff; ensure it exists and handles edge cases

recommendations.recommendation: Add comprehensive testing to verify CSP hashes match rendered content
recommendations.rationale: Even minor whitespace differences will break inline script/style execution

recommendations.recommendation: Document CSP policy directives and their specific security benefits
recommendations.rationale: Helps future maintainers understand the security model and make informed decisions about policy changes

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding X-UA-Compatible and other legacy security headers for broader browser support
recommendations.rationale: Improves security coverage for older browsers if compatibility is needed
